_comment: Tier-2 for skfem dg_methods#9, verified 2026-08-06 on skfem 12.0.1 / scipy 1.15.3. The upwind-DG advection matrix is genuinely non-symmetric (max|A - A.T| = 6.25e-02) and its symmetric part is only positive SEMI-definite. PARTIAL FALSIFICATION: scipy's cg does NOT raise 'RuntimeError: matrix not positive definite' -- it raises nothing at all, returns info = 1000 (maxiter) and a vector whose relative residual is 1.3e+03, so an exception-only gate accepts garbage. gmres (info 0, res 9.3e-11) and splu (res 8.0e-16, max|u-1| = 1.8e-15) both succeed.
